title: Plasma Orb Horses & Chick
description: A glowing plasma globe with a central lightning core contains two levitating brown horses with flowing blue manes running in mid-air. In the foreground, a cute yellow chick with blue eyes emerges from a cracked pink egg. The entire sphere emits vibrant pink, purple, and orange electrical arcs.
prompt: A magical plasma ball with a glowing central lightning core sits on a dark base labeled SLOT-32 SEED-53589. Inside the transparent sphere, two brown horses with flowing blue manes gallop in mid-air. In the foreground, an adorable yellow baby chick with big blue eyes hatches from a cracked pink egg. Vibrant pink, purple, and orange electrical arcs and sparks fill the orb against a dark mysterious background.
